activityLog.description: Researched Superframeworks micro-SaaS analysis. Key data: market $15.7B→$59.6B by 2030 (30% CAGR). 9% MRR lost to failed payments (dunning opportunity). Validation framework: 30 days = landing page + 20 signups + 10-20 interviews. Pattern: hyper-specialized AI tools outperforming generic.

Researched Flowjam micro-SaaS examples. Key patterns: local/offline niches (dog groomers $9k MRR, church CRM €22k MRR), SaaS-for-SaaS (Stripe analytics), creator economy tools. Best signal: "niche has <2000 attendees at annual conference" rule. All 27 examples have 1-3 person teams.

Researched trades software complaints. Key insight: big tools are "overkill" - giving Ferrari to pickup truck needs. Identified 5 new candidates: Job Pricer, Text Reminder, Photo Archive, Solo Profit Tracker, Material Estimator. All target $3-5/mo.

Researched trades (plumber/electrician) subreddits. Key insight: complaint is complexity/cost of big tools (Service Titan). Opportunity: single-purpose features those tools do poorly (job pricing history, simple profit tracking).
Eliminated Meeting Prep Generator (MeetingIQ free competitor). Down to 2 viable ideas. Pivoting to boring industries thesis: trades, local services, spreadsheet hell.

Researched EA/assistant pain points for niche targeting. Key areas: calendar management, email triage, travel coordination, competing priorities. Meeting Prep Generator still viable. Pattern: assistants price-sensitive but time savings = direct value.

Eliminated 2 more ideas: Weekly Digest Emailer (Google add-ons saturate), Follow-Up Tracker (Boomerang/FollowUpThen own space). Down to 2 viable + 1 needs validation. Pattern: obvious productivity tools are saturated, need niche/role-specific angles.

Eliminated Simple Mail Merge (Mailmeteor owns space at $10/mo, 6M users). Pivoted to niche-first thinking: targeting assistant/EA roles. Added 2 new candidates: Follow-Up Tracker, Meeting Prep Generator. 3 ideas remain viable.

Validated 5 more candidates. Eliminated: Spreadsheet Reminder (free add-on exists), Page Monitor (Visualping/free tools), Invoice Reminder (built into invoicing tools). 3-4 ideas still viable: Recurring File Deliveries, Meeting Cost Calculator, Weekly Digest Emailer, Simple Mail Merge.

Generated 5 new candidate ideas focused on single-purpose simplicity: Spreadsheet Reminder Bot, Weekly Digest Emailer, Simple Mail Merge, Ping Me When (page change monitor), Invoice Reminder Service. All target $3-5/mo price point.
